text:
jess (AE): quick one from VaultBank POC — they want tenant pinned to EU with BYOK for keys, but require automatic failover to APAC for availability. they demand a capped egress credit if traffic leaves EU. any ops/pricing precedent?

nina (SE): do they need active-active or active-passive? also do they expect warm cache in APAC during normal ops?

jess (AE): active-passive is fine. no warm cache needed. they want failovers to be rare (<4/month) and each event <10min. they want audit logs delivered to their S3 and proof of which subprocessors handled data.

leo (Legal): we can draft an SLA exception referencing number/duration limits and require automated audit proof. we usually avoid routing-based credits, but can add a one-time monthly egress credit cap and detailed reporting. need exact failover targets and whether Dedicated/Private is on table.

ravi (Infra): technical note: hosted routing uses affinity tags. default fallback order can be eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> ap-northeast-1. if BYOK + subproc exclusion required, customer must take Dedicated or Private. public-hosted APAC fallback will use our APAC cloud partner ("cloud-asia-1") and log transport via "logstreamer-co".

anya (Sales Eng): pricing mechanics: option A: EU Reserved Capacity (recommended) — minimizes failover chance. Option B: Reserved EU + small standby in APAC (hot-warm) — higher base price. Option C: EU Reserved + contract egress credit cap (e.g., €X / month) + SLA window clause. Rough delta: reserved adds ~25-40% depending on QPS; standby adds ~60%.

jess (AE): Leo — can you draft a short exception template we can share? also need list of exact APAC subprocessors we would hit during fallback (names + contact for SOC2 attestation).

leo (Legal): will draft. need: (1) exact fallback region(s) to include, (2) max failovers/month, (3) whether they want egress billed back or credited, (4) whether logs go to their S3 or via our console export.

jess (AE): they want fallback limited to ap-northeast-1 only, max 3 failovers/month, prefer an egress credit (not billing), logs to their S3, and BYOK.

ravi (Infra): noted. technical constraints: BYOK + S3 audit export = Dedicated or Private with VPC/VPN. public-hosted fallback will touch subprocessors: "cloud-asia-1" (compute), "logstreamer-co" (log forwarding), optionally "edge-cache-ap" (CDN). we can provide subprocessors list and SOC2 cert copies.

anya (Sales Eng): for quote i'll prepare two variants: (1) Hosted + EU Reserved + egress credit cap + runbook; (2) Dedicated (BYOK + subproc exclusion) with lower failover risk. i'll include a line for a monthly egress credit allowance (e.g., 2TB) and an overage rate.

nina (SE): i'll draft an operational runbook snippet to show how we detect and count failovers: details below — can reuse this in the contract.

nina (SE): runbook snippet:
```yaml
tenant_affinity: eu
preferred_region: eu-west-1
fallback_region: ap-northeast-1
failover_trigger_cpu_pct: 92
failover_window_secs: 600
failover_counting_rule: "an incident counts as a failover if >50% of requests for tenant are served from fallback in any 60s window"
audit_sink: s3://vaultbank-audit-exports/
```

leo (Legal): that counting rule is clear. i'll reference the YAML metrics in the exception. also will add remediation timelines for subprocessor attestation (we can share certs within 5 business days of request).

jess (AE): perfect. Anya — please flag pricing numbers as tentative. once we have draft legal language + pricing i will share with the buyer.

anya (Sales Eng): will send numbers today. estimate: EU reserved pool + €1500/mo egress credit cap (2TB) as a starting point. Dedicated pricing to follow.

ops-bot: synthetic-test: EU pool reached 94% at 2025-07-21T09:12:03Z, fallback triggered to ap-northeast-1 for 87s. audit log uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/fallback-tests/1765439999.log :white_check_mark:

jess (AE): awesome, thanks everyone. looping in buyer after Legal draft.
